dataset: AMI official full-corpus-ASR test; secondary forced-alignment reference rescore
evaluationRole: secondary reference sensitivity; manual only_words remains primary
annotationMethod: Montreal Forced Aligner; only_words; English G2P 3.0.0, acoustic model and dictionary 3.1.0; see pinned README
publication: Horiguchi et al., Can We Really Repurpose Multi-Speaker ASR Corpus for Speaker Diarization?, ASRU 2025
notes: Rescore the exact existing JSON predictions; do not run or tune inference again for this reference variant.
Same 32 recording IDs, audio URLs, conditions, durations and full-recording UEM hashes as the primary AMI manifest; 16 unique meetings.
The cited forced-alignment repository has one commit and all 16 AMI/test RTTMs. Individual downloaded RTTM hashes are frozen below.
The forced-alignment repository supplies no UEMs. Original pinned pyannote full-duration UEMs are intentionally retained for a controlled reference-only comparison.

The FluidInference model card reports 9.36% fast128 DER on MHM, collar 0, overlap included, and links this annotation repository. It does not publish exact per-run annotation hashes or all per-file predictions.

The FluidAudio SDK CLI uses its own 10 ms frame-based DiarizationDER, not our pinned NIST md-eval engine; it may fall back to manual labels when RTTMs are absent. Thus this rescore is not a guaranteed byte-for-byte reproduction of the vendor report.
Keep corpus-duration-weighted DER distinct from mean-per-meeting DER; the SDK batch summary computes an arithmetic mean.
Forced alignment can contain alignment or transcription errors; neither reference convention is automatically an absolute ground truth for every audible event.
Do not pool manual and forced scores, nor count MHM and SDM as independent meetings. Annotation statistics below count speaker time, including overlap, within unchanged UEMs.

durationSeconds on each recording is the original UEM end; audio.durationSeconds is the separately verified WAV duration. IS1009a/b/c/d SDM signals extend approximately 164/104/9.313/161.313 ms beyond their UEMs. Those tails are outside the fixed scoring region; neither audio nor reference timing is changed.
audioDurationPolicy: Validate each source against its frozen WAV frame count, sample format and byte length. Preserve original sample origin and fixed original UEM; do not trim, pad or shift the input.
